# Fixture: verbatim excerpts from REAL Viagogo pages fetched 2026-10-28.
#
# Source: browser fetches of the three artist pages Shariful's
# verify_live.py run checked (see LIVE_VERIFICATION.md § "What the real
# pages actually contain"). These excerpts are the evidence for the
# v1.5.1 root cause:
#   - the Real Madrid artist page contains NO prices at all — only
#     "3,895 people viewed … in the past hour", "Only 1% of tickets
#     left", "Selling fast", "Top seller".
#   - the FC Barcelona artist page contains NO prices — only event
#     names, dates and venues.
#   - the Metallica artist page DOES have per-event "From $X" prices.
#   - the per-event prices ("Tickets: 1,265.69 USD") live in
#     structured per-event data / single-event pages, NOT on the
#     artist pages — that format is in the last section below.
#
# Do not edit these excerpts to make a test pass — they are the record
# of what the real site showed that day.
